["Sec. 7 makes the order effective on July 1, 1957, or on a later date when funds appropriated for the National Security Council became available; no held source shows which date applied, and Sec. 3(b) directs transfers of Operations Coordinating Board staff whose performance date is also not held. EO 10920 (1961-02-18) revokes the order by name, but the start date and one-time transfers need held evidence, and EO 10838 amends section 1(b)."]

["Sec. 5 of the order directs transfer of records, property, personnel and funds of the Telecommunications Advisor to the Office of Defense Mobilization, and no held source shows whether or when that transfer was performed; without it the clause cannot be dated as exhausted by performance, and the 1962-02-16 revocation by EO 10995 Sec. 4 would not show first cessation. A held record of the transfer (agency order, budget document or Federal Register notice) is needed."]
